snippet.title: Catapulteers Demo Is Out — Co-op Catapult vs. One Giant Troll Physics Comedy
snippet.description:
Meet Catapulteers — a chaotic 1–4 player co-op physics game where cursed knights defend a fortress from a giant Troll using a giant catapult!
🎮 Play the demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4566710/Catapulteers

Haul cannonballs, giant chests, cheese, pumpkins, barrels, furniture, livestock, suspicious machinery, and sometimes your friends. Load the catapult. Launch bad ideas. Survive the consequences.

The Trolls have returned after centuries of peace. The old armory is useless. The fortress is falling apart. The only thing still working is the catapult.

Unfortunately, Trolls really hate catapults.

💥 Wishlist now and try the demo with friends.

#Catapulteers #IndieGame #CoopGame #SteamDemo #PhysicsGame
